arStrings.szText: {c_important}Advance{/c} rushes into enemies, granting {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} {c_important}{u}Fervor{/u}{/c} on each strike and deals an additional {c_number}[{SF_14} * 100|%x|]{/c} damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Fervor{/u}{/c} you have.

{c_important}Advance{/c} becomes a {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill. 

{c_important}Advance's{/c} impact waves out, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_CONE_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and gains {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} for every {c_number}1{/c} meter you dash.

{c_important}Advance{/c} becomes a {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skill and has a {if:SF_20}{c_number}{Cooldown Time}{/c}{else}{c_number}{SF_9}{/c}{/if} second cooldown.

{c_important}Advance{/c} becomes a dash that cuts through enemies, applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_MAIN_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Advance{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance for {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} seconds.

Grants {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} of Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:FORTIFY})|0|]){/c} as {u}{c_important}Fortify{/c}{/u} when {c_important}Advance{/c} hits an enemy for the first time.
